hablar-que-importa-mas.title: Talk about what matters most to you at the wedding
hablar-que-importa-mas.hint: Deciding your priorities helps you split the money without arguing.

preguntar-con-cuanta-ayuda.title: Ask how much help you can count on from family
preguntar-con-cuanta-ayuda.hint: Find out early whether parents or grandparents are contributing, and how, so you can adjust the total.

abrir-una-cuenta-conjunta.title: Open a joint account for the wedding
abrir-una-cuenta-conjunta.hint: It makes it easier to save, pay deposits and see all your spending in one place.

comparar-temporada-alta-baja.title: Compare peak and off-peak season
comparar-temporada-alta-baja.hint: On weekdays or outside May–September, venues and catering are usually cheaper.

consultar-fechas-con-familiares.title: Check dates with key family members
consultar-fechas-con-familiares.hint: Avoid clashing with other weddings, long weekends, communions or local festivals.

calcular-coste-por-invitado.title: Work out the cost per guest
calcular-coste-por-invitado.hint: The banquet and venue scale with every guest: try 60, 80 and 100.

apuntar-los-sobres-regalos.title: Note the cash gifts and presents you expect to receive
apuntar-los-sobres-regalos.hint: A cautious estimate of guests' gifts helps, but don't take it for granted.

reservar-colchon-del-5.title: Set aside a 5–10% cushion for the unexpected
reservar-colchon-del-5.hint: Extras always come up: fittings, alterations, tips, extra hours.

revisar-presupuesto-con-contratado.title: Review the budget against what you've booked
revisar-presupuesto-con-contratado.hint: Every quarter, compare what you planned with what you've paid and adjust.

pactar-quien-paga-cada.title: Agree on who pays for what, and when
pactar-quien-paga-cada.hint: Note each vendor's deposits and payment dates so there are no surprises.

definir-cuantos-invitados-quereis.title: Decide the maximum number of guests
definir-cuantos-invitados-quereis.hint: Set a realistic cap before starting the list: it shapes your venue and budget.

acordar-los-criterios-invitacion.title: Agree on your invitation criteria
acordar-los-criterios-invitacion.hint: For example: people you've spoken to this year, partners, children, coworkers.

repartir-cupos-entre-vosotros.title: Split the guest quotas between you and your families
repartir-cupos-entre-vosotros.hint: A clear split (for example, 40/40/20) avoids tension with parents and in-laws.

separar-lista-lista.title: Split the list into an A list and a B list
separar-lista-lista.hint: The B list is only invited if there are cancellations; it helps you adjust without stress.

recoger-direcciones-telefonos-todos.title: Collect everyone's address and phone number
recoger-direcciones-telefonos-todos.hint: Ask for postal addresses if you're sending paper invitations.

preguntar-por-alergias-intolerancias.title: Ask about allergies and intolerances
preguntar-por-alergias-intolerancias.hint: The caterer needs this in advance: coeliacs, allergies, vegetarians.

decidir-invita-ninos-que.title: Decide whether to invite children, and from what age
decidir-invita-ninos-que.hint: If there will be children, think about a kids' menu and an area or entertainment for them.

confirmar-asistentes-por-llamada.title: Confirm attendance by phone or message
confirmar-asistentes-por-llamada.hint: Gently chase the pending replies before the deadline.

pedir-confirmacion-menu-cada.title: Ask each guest to confirm their menu choice
pedir-confirmacion-menu-cada.hint: If there are menu options, note them on the list to pass on to the caterer.

asignar-cada-invitado-una.title: Assign each guest a table
asignar-cada-invitado-una.hint: Group people by affinity and spread out any family tensions.

preparar-plano-mesas-con.title: Prepare the seating plan with the caterer
preparar-plano-mesas-con.hint: Share the final plan and the list of dietary needs with the venue.

avisar-los-invitados-bajas.title: Tell the venue about last-minute cancellations
avisar-los-invitados-bajas.hint: If anything changes, let the caterer know as soon as possible to avoid extra charges.

hacer-una-lista-corta.title: Make a shortlist of venues
hacer-una-lista-corta.hint: Search by area, capacity and price; narrow it down based on your guest list.

preguntar-fechas-libres-precio.title: Ask about available dates and price per guest
preguntar-fechas-libres-precio.hint: One email to several venues lets you compare availability and rates at once.

comprobar-espacio-incluye-catering.title: Check whether the venue includes its own catering
comprobar-espacio-incluye-catering.hint: Some venues require their own caterer; others let you choose yours.

preguntar-por-horario-maximo.title: Ask about the latest finishing time and noise limit
preguntar-por-horario-maximo.hint: Confirm until what time music is allowed and whether the open bar is charged by the hour.

ver-plan-llueve.title: See the rain plan
ver-plan-llueve.hint: Ask to see the alternative hall or marquee and how much it costs to set up.

confirmar-accesos-parking-accesibilidad.title: Confirm access, parking and accessibility
confirmar-accesos-parking-accesibilidad.hint: Think about older guests, wheelchairs, high heels and baby strollers.

preguntar-que-mobiliario-decoracion.title: Ask what furniture and decor is included
preguntar-que-mobiliario-decoracion.hint: Tables, chairs, linens, tableware and glassware: it can save or cost you a lot.

pedir-contrato-revisar-politica.title: Ask for the contract and review the cancellation policy
pedir-contrato-revisar-politica.hint: Read the deposit, payment deadlines and what happens if the guest count changes.

preguntar-por-hora-acceso.title: Ask about the access time for setup
preguntar-por-hora-acceso.hint: Florists, decorators and musicians need to get in with plenty of time.

repasar-con-espacio-distribucion.title: Go over the hall layout with the venue
repasar-con-espacio-distribucion.hint: Tables, dance floor, bar and stage: sketch it out with the venue team.

pedir-lista-proveedores-recomendados.title: Ask for the venue's list of recommended vendors
pedir-lista-proveedores-recomendados.hint: They know the place and often have fixed rates or access permits already sorted.

hacer-una-ultima-visita.title: Do a final walkthrough with key vendors
hacer-una-ultima-visita.hint: With the photographer, DJ and decorator, check power outlets, lighting and spaces.

hacer-una-lista-proveedores.title: Make a list of must-have vendors
hacer-una-lista-proveedores.hint: Decide what's essential (catering, photographer, music) and what can wait.

pedir-presupuesto-3-fotografos.title: Get quotes from 3 photographers or videographers
pedir-presupuesto-3-fotografos.hint: Compare style, hours of coverage, deliverables and delivery time.

ver-albumes-completos-bodas.title: Look at full albums from past weddings
ver-albumes-completos-bodas.hint: A whole wedding tells you more than a portfolio of their best shots.

reservar-peluqueria-maquillaje.title: Book hair and makeup
reservar-peluqueria-maquillaje.hint: Include a trial and ask whether they travel to the wedding location.

elegir-florista-definir-estilo.title: Choose a florist and define your floral style
elegir-florista-definir-estilo.hint: Bring inspiration photos and your color palette.

encargar-tarta-nupcial.title: Order the wedding cake
encargar-tarta-nupcial.hint: Ask for a flavor tasting and whether setup and delivery are included.

probar-menu-con-catering.title: Taste the menu with the caterer
probar-menu-con-catering.hint: Choose starters, mains and dessert, and review the kids' menu and dietary options.

preguntar-por-recena-barra.title: Ask about the late-night snack and open bar
preguntar-por-recena-barra.hint: Clarify what's included, until when, and whether extra hours carry a surcharge.

contratar-animacion-cuidadores-para.title: Hire entertainers or sitters for the children
contratar-animacion-cuidadores-para.hint: Having someone to help frees up the parents and avoids mishaps during the banquet.

firmar-todos-los-contratos.title: Sign all contracts and keep copies
firmar-todos-los-contratos.hint: Check services, schedules, extras and the cancellation policy before signing.

anotar-fechas-pago-senales.title: Note each vendor's payment dates and deposits
anotar-fechas-pago-senales.hint: Put them in your calendar so you don't miss a payment.

dar-cada-proveedor-cronograma.title: Give every vendor the final schedule
dar-cada-proveedor-cronograma.hint: Include times, contacts and addresses; everyone should know what happens and when.

confirmar-por-telefono-con.title: Confirm by phone with each vendor
confirmar-por-telefono-con.hint: A call the week before avoids last-minute misunderstandings.

preparar-sobres-con-pago.title: Prepare envelopes with each vendor's final payment
preparar-sobres-con-pago.hint: Label them and put a trusted person in charge of handing them over.

decidir-ceremonia-mismo-sitio.title: Decide whether the ceremony is at the same place as the banquet
decidir-ceremonia-mismo-sitio.hint: It saves travel and time; for a church or town hall you'll need to organize transport.

preguntar-por-horarios-disponibilidad.title: Ask about the venue's times and availability
preguntar-por-horarios-disponibilidad.hint: Churches, courts and town halls have fixed time slots: book well ahead.

elegir-las-personas-que.title: Choose the people who will be with you at the ceremony
elegir-las-personas-que.hint: Best man, maid of honor, witnesses, page boys and ring bearers.

elegir-lecturas-poemas-textos.title: Choose readings, poems or texts for the ceremony
elegir-lecturas-poemas-textos.hint: Family or friends can read them; let them know in advance so they can rehearse.

escribir-los-votos.title: Write your vows
escribir-los-votos.hint: Short and personal: a minute each is plenty, and it tends to be moving.

elegir-musica-entrada-firma.title: Choose the music for the entrance, the signing and the exit
elegir-musica-entrada-firma.hint: Three key moments: the entrance, the signing and the recessional.

preparar-ensayo-ceremonia.title: Plan a ceremony rehearsal
preparar-ensayo-ceremonia.hint: Go over positions and the order of entry with the officiant and your party.

decidir-como-colocar-familia.title: Decide how to seat the family during the ceremony
decidir-como-colocar-familia.hint: Reserve the front rows for parents and grandparents; tell them where to sit.

comprar-encargar-ramo-las.title: Buy or order the bouquet and ceremony flowers
comprar-encargar-ramo-las.hint: Includes the bouquet, family boutonnieres and corsages, and the altar or table decor.

preparar-cojin-caja-para.title: Prepare the cushion or box for the rings
preparar-cojin-caja-para.hint: Someone you trust keeps them safe until the exchange.

imprimir-programa-misal-ceremonia.title: Print the ceremony program
imprimir-programa-misal-ceremonia.hint: Optional: it helps guests follow the readings and songs.

preparar-arroz-petalos-confeti.title: Get the rice, petals or confetti for the exit
preparar-arroz-petalos-confeti.hint: Ask first what the venue allows; some ban rice.

pedir-cita-registro-civil.title: Book an appointment at the civil registry or notary
pedir-cita-registro-civil.hint: For a civil wedding, book the appointment for the paperwork according to your municipality.

pedir-certificado-literal-nacimiento.title: Request the full birth certificate
pedir-certificado-literal-nacimiento.hint: It can be requested online or at the Civil Registry; it usually needs to be recent.

obtener-certificado-empadronamiento.title: Get the certificate of residence (empadronamiento)
obtener-certificado-empadronamiento.hint: Request it at the town hall or online; one for each of you if you live apart.

conseguir-certificado-estado-civil.title: Get the certificate of marital status if needed
conseguir-certificado-estado-civil.hint: Needed if you've been married before or live outside Spain.

preparar-copias-del-dni.title: Prepare copies of both your ID or passports
preparar-copias-del-dni.hint: Check they won't expire before the wedding or the honeymoon.

elegir-los-testigos-del.title: Choose the marriage witnesses
elegir-los-testigos-del.hint: There are usually two (civil ceremony); they must be adults with valid ID and present on the day.

pedir-partida-bautismo-reciente.title: Request a recent baptism certificate
pedir-partida-bautismo-reciente.hint: For a religious ceremony, request it from the parish where you were baptized.

hacer-expediente-parroquial.title: Complete the parish paperwork
hacer-expediente-parroquial.hint: For a religious ceremony, it's handled at the parish with documents and an interview.

apuntarse-cursillo-prematrimonial.title: Sign up for the pre-marriage course
apuntarse-cursillo-prematrimonial.hint: For a religious ceremony it's usually mandatory; places fill up, so book early.

confirmar-con-parroquia-oficiante.title: Confirm the required documents with the parish or officiant
confirmar-con-parroquia-oficiante.hint: Each diocese and municipality asks for something different: confirm before chasing paperwork.

preguntar-por-posibles-tramites.title: Ask about any paperwork for a symbolic ceremony
preguntar-por-posibles-tramites.hint: It has no legal validity on its own; decide whether you want to sign at the registry first.

decidir-regimen-economico-matrimonial.title: Decide your marital property regime
decidir-regimen-economico-matrimonial.hint: Community property or separate property; ask a notary if you have doubts.

anotar-fechas-horas-todas.title: Note the dates and times of all legal appointments
anotar-fechas-horas-todas.hint: Set calendar alerts: certificates are only valid for a short time.

pedir-libro-familia-tras.title: Request the family book (libro de familia) after the wedding
pedir-libro-familia-tras.hint: It's processed at the Civil Registry after the wedding; keep the certificate.

cambiar-domicilio-titulares-contratos.title: Update your address and contract holders if needed
cambiar-domicilio-titulares-contratos.hint: Bank, insurance, mortgage or rental: update them after the wedding with the family book.

guardar-fotos-inspiracion-looks.title: Save inspiration photos for your looks
guardar-fotos-inspiracion-looks.hint: Create a folder with styles, cuts and colors before you head to the shops.

fijar-presupuesto-vestuario.title: Set an attire budget
fijar-presupuesto-vestuario.hint: Include alterations, accessories, underwear and a second outfit if you want one.

pedir-cita-varios-talleres.title: Book appointments at several boutiques or ateliers
pedir-cita-varios-talleres.hint: A made-to-measure dress can take 6 to 10 months: book early.

elegir-zapatos-comprobar-que.title: Choose shoes and check they're comfortable
elegir-zapatos-comprobar-que.hint: Break them in at home for a few days and bring a second pair for dancing.

elegir-velo-tocado-complementos.title: Choose the veil, headpiece and accessories
elegir-velo-tocado-complementos.hint: Match them with your hairstyle and neckline; try them on with the dress.

elegir-ropa-interior-para.title: Choose underwear for the dress
elegir-ropa-interior-para.hint: Bring it to the fittings so the adjustments are right.

elegir-camisa-corbata-pajarita.title: Choose the groom's shirt, tie or bow tie and shoes
elegir-camisa-corbata-pajarita.hint: Coordinate colors with the bouquet and the wedding party.

decidir-vestuario-pajes-damas.title: Decide the outfits for pages, bridesmaids and groomsmen
decidir-vestuario-pajes-damas.hint: Let them know in advance and tell them the color or style you want.

hacer-prueba-final-los.title: Do the final fitting and last alterations
hacer-prueba-final-los.hint: Go with your final shoes and accessories; confirm when to pick everything up.

preparar-kit-emergencia-para.title: Pack an emergency kit for the day
preparar-kit-emergencia-para.hint: Pins, thread, plasters, tissues, safety pins, makeup and spare shoes.

encargar-quien-cuidara-del.title: Appoint someone to look after the dress and suit
encargar-quien-cuidara-del.hint: Assign someone to hang them, transport them and help with buttons or zippers.

planificar-limpieza-conservacion-posteri.title: Plan the cleaning and storage afterwards
planificar-limpieza-conservacion-posteri.hint: Take the dress to a specialist dry cleaner and store it in a garment bag.

definir-estilo-visual-boda.title: Define the visual style of the wedding
definir-estilo-visual-boda.hint: Color palette, typography and motifs that repeat across all your stationery.

pedir-presupuesto-3-imprentas.title: Get quotes from 3 printers
pedir-presupuesto-3-imprentas.hint: Compare paper, finishes, minimum quantity and delivery times.

redactar-texto-invitacion.title: Write the invitation text
redactar-texto-invitacion.hint: Include who is inviting, date, time, locations, dress code and RSVP deadline.

crear-una-web-codigo.title: Create a website or QR code for the wedding
crear-una-web-codigo.hint: One link with maps, schedules, accommodation and gift list saves a lot of questions.

imprimir-una-prueba-antes.title: Print a proof before ordering the full run
imprimir-una-prueba-antes.hint: Check typos, colors and sizes; real paper looks very different from a screen.

encargar-sobres-sellos-lacre.title: Order envelopes and seals or wax
encargar-sobres-sellos-lacre.hint: Count a few extra invitations in case of mistakes or last-minute guests.

disenar-menu-seating-los.title: Design the menu, seating chart and place cards
disenar-menu-seating-los.hint: Menu, seating plan, table names: order them once the guest list is final.

preparar-cartel-bienvenida.title: Prepare the welcome sign
preparar-cartel-bienvenida.hint: A sign at the entrance of the venue or banquet with your names.

encargar-las-tarjetas-agradecimiento.title: Order the thank-you cards
encargar-las-tarjetas-agradecimiento.hint: They're left on the table or sent to each guest afterwards.

preparar-libro-firmas-dedicatorias.title: Prepare the guest book
preparar-libro-firmas-dedicatorias.hint: An alternative: cards to leave a message or an instant photo.

fijar-fecha-limite-para.title: Set the RSVP deadline
fijar-fecha-limite-para.hint: Make it 4–6 weeks before the wedding and repeat it on the invitation.

hacer-una-lista-invitados.title: Make a list of guests coming from out of town
hacer-una-lista-invitados.hint: You'll know how many rooms and transport seats you need.

pedir-bloqueo-habitaciones-hoteles.title: Ask nearby hotels for a room block
pedir-bloqueo-habitaciones-hoteles.hint: Ask about the group rate and the deadline to release rooms at no cost.

reservar-alojamiento-para-familia.title: Book accommodation for close family and the wedding party
reservar-alojamiento-para-familia.hint: It avoids last-minute rushes and makes the day's preparations easier.

reservar-suite-habitacion-los.title: Book the couple's suite or room
reservar-suite-habitacion-los.hint: To get ready, rest and spend the wedding night, if you're not going home.

contratar-autobuses-microbuses-para.title: Hire buses or minibuses for guests
contratar-autobuses-microbuses-para.hint: Round trips between hotel, ceremony and venue; match the times to your schedule.

reservar-coche-los-novios.title: Book the couple's car
reservar-coche-los-novios.hint: A classic car or a chauffeur for the ceremony or the exit from the banquet.

dar-los-invitados-una.title: Give guests a guide with schedules and routes
dar-los-invitados-una.hint: Include maps, parking, bus stops and phone numbers for local taxis.

hacer-una-lista-taxis.title: Make a list of local taxis and ride-hailing options
hacer-una-lista-taxis.hint: For those who don't want to drive after the party; note down contact numbers.

preparar-una-bolsa-bienvenida.title: Prepare a welcome bag for guests staying overnight
preparar-una-bolsa-bienvenida.hint: Water, a map, a snack and the weekend's program.

confirmar-horarios-del-autobus.title: Confirm the bus schedule with the company
confirmar-horarios-del-autobus.hint: Check stops, number of seats and the return time after the party.

designar-una-persona-contacto.title: Appoint a transport contact person
designar-una-persona-contacto.hint: Someone you trust to coordinate arrivals, pick-ups and drop-offs during the day.

decidir-preferis-recibir-dinero.title: Decide whether you'd rather receive money or a list of items
decidir-preferis-recibir-dinero.hint: Money is the most common and avoids duplicates; a list is more traditional and many people find it more personal. You can change your mind.

decidir-quereis-cuenta-bancaria.title: Decide whether you want a bank account, Bizum or both
decidir-quereis-cuenta-bancaria.hint: A bank transfer works for all ages; Bizum is quick for anyone with the app.

repasar-que-falta-casa.title: Review what you're missing at home before building the list
repasar-que-falta-casa.hint: Walk through the kitchen, bathroom and bedroom with a notebook: what's broken, what's old and what you've never had.

incluir-cosas-distinto-precio.title: Include items at different price points
incluir-cosas-distinto-precio.hint: Mix small touches with bigger items so everyone can find something that suits them.

anadir-enlace-precio-aproximado.title: Add a link and an approximate price to each item
anadir-enlace-precio-aproximado.hint: If guests can find it in one click, they're more likely to get the model and color you want.

marcar-las-cosas-mas.title: Mark the most important items on the list
marcar-las-cosas-mas.hint: Prioritize what you really need (appliances, bed linen) and leave the treats for last.

marcando-lista-que-teneis.title: Keep marking off what you've already received
marcando-lista-que-teneis.hint: That way the invitation only shows what's still pending and you avoid getting the same thing twice.

pedir-los-invitados-que.title: Ask guests to let you know before buying something from the list
pedir-los-invitados-que.hint: One sentence in the message is enough: “Message us before buying so nothing gets duplicated.”

guardar-los-tickets-los.title: Keep the gift receipts so items can be exchanged
guardar-los-tickets-los.hint: Ask for a gift receipt at the shop and note who gave what for the thank-yous.

elegir-una-cuenta-que.title: Choose an account that you both control
elegir-una-cuenta-que.hint: It can be joint or one of yours; check that it doesn't charge fees for incoming transfers.

decidir-para-que-quereis.title: Decide what you want the money for
decidir-para-que-quereis.hint: Honeymoon, a house deposit, renovations or shared savings: telling guests helps them give.

redactar-mensaje-breve-carinoso.title: Write a short, warm message asking for money instead of gifts
redactar-mensaje-breve-carinoso.hint: Two or three sentences, without pressure: what matters is that they come. Keep it positive.

revisar-iban-bizum-antes.title: Double-check the IBAN and Bizum details before sharing them
revisar-iban-bizum-antes.hint: Copy and paste instead of typing, and ask someone else to check it.

decidir-donde-veran-los.title: Decide where the details will be shown
decidir-donde-veran-los.hint: On the invitation, on the wedding website or only to those who ask; choose what feels most comfortable.

preparar-una-respuesta-para.title: Prepare a reply for anyone who insists on giving a physical gift
preparar-una-respuesta-para.hint: A kind sentence ready to repeat: “Your company is the best gift; if you like, a contribution to the honeymoon.”

decidir-como-recoger-los.title: Decide how to collect envelopes and parcels that arrive on the wedding day
decidir-como-recoger-los.hint: A discreet box or urn and a trusted person to look after it and take everything home.

anotar-quien-regalado-cuanto.title: Note who gave what
anotar-quien-regalado-cuanto.hint: It makes thank-yous easier and avoids oversights; a quick note on your phone is enough.

enviar-mensajes-agradecimiento-personali.title: Send personalized thank-you messages
enviar-mensajes-agradecimiento-personali.hint: A short, sincere note to each person, ideally within the first few weeks, saying what you'll use the money for.

repasar-cronograma-con-padrinos.title: Go over the schedule with the best man, maid of honor and witnesses
repasar-cronograma-con-padrinos.hint: It's easier if they know when they need to be there and what's expected of them.

dejar-margen-entre-los.title: Leave a buffer between key moments
dejar-margen-entre-los.hint: Surprises happen; a 10–15 minute cushion between moments helps a lot.

acordar-con-fotografo-las.title: Agree the must-have photos with the photographer
acordar-con-fotografo-las.hint: Prepare a list of family photos with names to save time.

calcular-horas-peluqueria-maquillaje.title: Work out the time for hair, makeup and getting dressed
calcular-horas-peluqueria-maquillaje.hint: Allow extra time: it always runs long, and the getting-ready photos need room too.

avisar-los-invitados-hora.title: Tell guests what time to arrive
avisar-los-invitados-hora.hint: Set an arrival time 20–30 minutes before the ceremony.

planificar-las-comidas-los.title: Plan the couple's meals during the day
planificar-las-comidas-los.hint: Something light before getting dressed; afterwards there's little time to eat in peace.

pasar-cronograma-catering-finca.title: Send the schedule to the caterer and the venue
pasar-cronograma-catering-finca.hint: Service, cocktail hour, banquet and late-night snack times need to fit the timings.

asignar-responsable-del-dia.title: Assign a day-of person to each task
asignar-responsable-del-dia.hint: A trusted person takes care of vendors, gifts or the children.

imprimir-copias-del-cronograma.title: Print copies of the schedule
imprimir-copias-del-cronograma.hint: One for each of the wedding party, the photographer and the venue manager.

preparar-lista-musica-para.title: Prepare the music list for each moment
preparar-lista-musica-para.hint: Entrance, cocktail hour, banquet, first dance and party: pass it to the DJ or band.

decidir-cuanto-presupuesto-dedicais.title: Decide how much budget to put toward the trip
decidir-cuanto-presupuesto-dedicais.hint: A cap per person helps you choose the destination and length.

elegir-epoca-del-ano.title: Choose the right time of year for your destination
elegir-epoca-del-ano.hint: Check the weather, rainy or monsoon season, and prices on those dates.

decidir-que-tipo-viaje.title: Decide what kind of trip you want
decidir-que-tipo-viaje.hint: Beach, city, adventure or a road trip; rest or see as much as possible?

comprobar-visados-vacunas-requisitos.title: Check visas, vaccines and entry requirements
comprobar-visados-vacunas-requisitos.hint: Some countries require a passport valid for months or an entry permit.

contratar-seguro-viaje.title: Get travel insurance
contratar-seguro-viaje.hint: Check cancellation and medical cover, especially for a faraway trip.

valorar-viaje-novios-posterior.title: Consider a later honeymoon instead of an immediate one
valorar-viaje-novios-posterior.hint: If work or budget doesn't line up, you can do it a few months later.

avisar-hotel-que-viaje.title: Tell the hotel it's a honeymoon trip
avisar-hotel-que-viaje.hint: Many hotels offer a little gift or a room upgrade.

reservar-las-actividades-restaurantes.title: Book the key activities and restaurants
reservar-las-actividades-restaurantes.hint: Excursions and special dinners sell out; book the must-haves.

planificar-traslado-desde-boda.title: Plan the transfer from the wedding to the airport
planificar-traslado-desde-boda.hint: Think about how you leave the venue, where you leave the car and what time your flight is.

hacer-las-maletas-semana.title: Pack your suitcases the week before the wedding
hacer-las-maletas-semana.hint: So you don't stress; keep a corner for documents and chargers.

dejar-alguien-encargado-casa.title: Ask someone to look after the house and pets
dejar-alguien-encargado-casa.hint: Plants, mail, pets and keys: let a relative or neighbor know.

elegir-una-persona-confianza.title: Choose a trusted person as the day-of coordinator
elegir-una-persona-confianza.hint: Someone who isn't the bride or groom and can answer questions from vendors and guests.

hacer-una-cuenta-atras.title: Make a month-by-month task countdown
hacer-una-cuenta-atras.hint: Spreading tasks across the months stops everything piling up in the last weeks.

comprar-las-alianzas.title: Buy the wedding rings
comprar-las-alianzas.hint: Engrave names or the date; engraving usually takes a few weeks.

preparar-los-detalles-para.title: Prepare the guest favors
preparar-los-detalles-para.hint: Ideas: fans, sweets, plants or a note; work out the exact number.

planificar-los-discursos-quien.title: Plan the speeches and who speaks
planificar-los-discursos-quien.hint: Tell the speakers in advance and ask them to keep it short.

preparar-video-sorpresa-una.title: Prepare a surprise video or photo slideshow
preparar-video-sorpresa-una.hint: Ask family and friends for photos ahead of time; a few minutes is plenty.

cuidar-vosotros-citas-descanso.title: Look after yourselves: date nights, rest and exercise
cuidar-vosotros-citas-descanso.hint: Set aside time for the two of you, without talking about the wedding or lists.

contratar-seguro-bodas.title: Get wedding insurance
contratar-seguro-bodas.hint: It covers cancellations, damage or vendor failures; compare coverage.

preparar-una-bolsa-emergencia.title: Pack an emergency bag for the day
preparar-una-bolsa-emergencia.hint: Medication, chargers, spare shoes, plasters, cash.

preparar-una-caja-regalo.title: Prepare a gift box and keepsakes for your parents
preparar-una-caja-regalo.hint: A thank-you gesture for parents, the wedding party and everyone who helped.

planificar-quien-recoge-decoracion.title: Plan who collects the decor at the end
planificar-quien-recoge-decoracion.hint: Flowers, signs, gifts and personal items all need to go home.

preparar-noche-bodas-manana.title: Plan the wedding night and the morning after
preparar-noche-bodas-manana.hint: Book the accommodation, pack a bag and plan a relaxed breakfast.

steps.title: Ideas for {{title}}
steps.description: Tap + to add a task to this step. You decide.
steps.empty: You already have all of these tasks. So organized!

venue.hint: It sets the date, capacity and style of the wedding. It's the first thing to book.

catering.hint: Cocktail hour, banquet, late-night snack and open bar. Always ask for a menu tasting.

photographer.hint: The good ones book up fast. Look at full weddings, not just the portfolio.

video.hint: A short film or a full-length feature; coordinate with the photographer so you don't get in each other's way.

music.hint: A DJ or band for the cocktail hour and the party. Ask about equipment, repertoire and hours.

ceremonyMusic.hint: A choir, violin or string quartet for the entrance, signing and exit.

flowers.hint: Bouquet, ceremony and centerpieces. Seasonal flowers save money.

decor.hint: Ambience, lighting and extra furniture; the venue may include it.

cake.hint: Wedding cake or dessert table. Ask for a flavor tasting and delivery on site.

hairMakeup.hint: Book with a trial run and check whether they travel to the wedding location.

dress.hint: A bridal boutique or atelier. Book an appointment early: made-to-measure takes 6 to 10 months.

suit.hint: Made-to-measure, bought or rented. Leave time for fittings and alterations.

rings.hint: A jeweler or workshop. Engraving and resizing take a few weeks.

transport.hint: A car for the couple and buses for guests if the venue is far away.

kidsEntertainment.hint: Entertainers and games for the little ones: parents enjoy the banquet more.

photoBooth.hint: It entertains guests and leaves a keepsake; ask about prints and props.

weddingPlanner.hint: Coordinates vendors and the wedding day. Handy if you're short on time.

invitations.hint: A printer or designer. Ask for a paper proof and timelines before sending.

vendors.title: Vendor ideas
vendors.description: You might be missing these types. Choosing one opens the form with the category filled in.
vendors.empty: You have all the usual vendor types. Nice work!

fotos-pareja-antes.title: Couple photos before the ceremony
fotos-pareja-antes.hint: The “first look” option: you see each other beforehand and relax.

llegada-invitados.title: Guest arrival
llegada-invitados.hint: Soft music, water or fans while they take their seats.

entrada-del-novio.title: Groom's entrance
entrada-del-novio.hint: Usually accompanied by his mother or the maid of honor.

entrada-novia.title: Bride's entrance
entrada-novia.hint: With your chosen music, accompanied by her father or someone special.

lecturas.title: Readings
lecturas.hint: Two or three short readings by family or friends.

lectura-votos.title: Vows
lectura-votos.hint: A minute each; best written on paper in case of nerves.

intercambio-alianzas.title: Exchange of rings
intercambio-alianzas.hint: The ring bearer hands over the rings at this moment.

firma-del-acta.title: Signing of the register
firma-del-acta.hint: With witnesses and background music; a good moment for a photo.

salida-con-arroz.title: Exit with rice or petals
salida-con-arroz.hint: Check beforehand that the venue allows it.

fotos-familia.title: Family photos
fotos-familia.hint: Bring a list of groups with names so it goes quickly.

coctel-bienvenida.title: Welcome cocktail hour
coctel-bienvenida.hint: While the couple takes their photos, guests enjoy the appetizers.

fotos-pareja.title: Couple photos
fotos-pareja.hint: Make the most of the afternoon light; the cocktail hour covers you without anyone missing you.

entrada-banquete.title: Entrance to the banquet
entrada-banquete.hint: The couple's entrance with their favorite song.

banquete-discursos.title: Banquet and speeches
banquete-discursos.hint: Speak between courses so the food doesn't go cold; ask for brevity.

video-sorpresa.title: Surprise video
video-sorpresa.hint: Check the projector and sound beforehand; best between the main course and dessert.

corte-tarta.title: Cake cutting
corte-tarta.hint: Do it with a photo and a toast; it's then served with coffee.

entrega-detalles.title: Handing out favors
entrega-detalles.hint: The couple visits the tables or leaves them at each seat with a note.

lanzamiento-del-ramo.title: Bouquet toss
lanzamiento-del-ramo.hint: Optional; sometimes swapped for a bouquet for the maid of honor or grandmother.

primer-baile.title: First dance
primer-baile.hint: Rehearse a little and tell the DJ the song and the moment.

apertura-barra-libre.title: Open bar opens
apertura-barra-libre.hint: Confirm the start and end times with the caterer.

recena.title: Late-night snack
recena.hint: Sandwiches, mini burgers, croquettes or chocolate with churros.

fin-fiesta.title: End of the party
fin-fiesta.hint: Last song and goodbyes; agree the exact time with the venue.

autobus-vuelta.title: Bus back
autobus-vuelta.hint: Let guests know the times and stops for getting back.

fields.linkHint: Optional. If you only have it on paper, leave it empty and add a note.
